messages:
Sarah K.: Heads up — trying to lock down Partner Governance Rubric v2 + MDF roll‑forward logic before Friday's QBR. Need quick eyes from finance / marketplace / SI ops.
Diego R.: Can you drop the sheet? where do the new weights live?
Sarah K.: Link: https://redwood.co/sheets/partner-gov-v2 (working copy). Key changes: revenue weight -> 30%, engagement -> 25%, strategic bets -> 25%, compliance -> 20%. MDF trigger rules added: score < 60 => MDF hold. Also adding a 'marketplace readiness' flag that can auto‑unlock co‑marketing credits.
Priya S.: Marketplace — that readiness flag is huge. How do we compute it?
Sarah K.: Rule of thumb: 2 of 3 must be true: listing published, integration smoke tests green, AND 1 marketplace customer reference. Formula snippet: `score = 0.3*rev_norm + 0.25*eng_norm + 0.25*strat_norm + 0.2*comp_norm` (all 0–100). MDF allocation tiers: >85 -> full, 70–85 -> 50%, 60–70 -> 25%, <60 -> hold.
Tom L.: For SIs, "integration smoke tests" may lag. Suggest a probation token that allows provisional credits for 8 weeks while integration is completed.
Maya P.: Ops note: we need Salesforce flags + marketplace tags to surface the readiness bit. I'll need a field spec to hand to infra for automation.
Diego R.: Finance: need a quick reforecast for Q3 MDF impact if we enforce hold rule. Ballpark estimate: expect ~30% of current request volume to be held pending remediation. I'll run numbers if you confirm the rule.
Sarah K.: Confirming — please run the reforecast. Scheduling a 20‑min sync Wed 1pm PT to finalize language for the QBR slide. Quick poll — react with :thumbsup: to commit to v2 for the QBR.
Priya S.: :thumbsup: One request — can we add a "headless listing" metric for hardware partners (shows firmware images + sample manifests)? That should live in engagement bucket.
Sarah K.: Good call, adding headless listing to engagement metrics. Action items (quick):
- Diego: MDF reforecast by Tue EOD
- Maya: SFDC field spec + runbook ticket
- Tom: probation token workflow draft
- Priya: sample checklist for marketplace readiness
- Sarah: finalize rubric doc & update QBR slide
partner-bot: Reminder — Partner QBR template updated: /shared-drive/qbr/partner-template-v2.pptx
Maya P.: Opened runbook ticket TKT-4823 and added basic SFDC field spec to the ticket.
Diego R.: Will share reforecast by Tue EOD. +1 on probation token.
Sarah K.: Thanks everyone — if no objections I'll publish the v2 sheet Wed morning and call it in for Friday's QBR. Ping me directly if you see blockers.
